values.note: A reservation is required (cpwshop.com or 1-800-244-5613), up to six months ahead, winter included; a vehicle pass must be displayed. 14 days within a 28-day period; six people, two motorized vehicles and one camping unit per site. Check-in 1 p.m., check-out noon.

values.note: Electric sites $36 a night (the RV sites; the $28 single sites here are the tent loops). Plus tax, CPW's per-stay reservation fee, and a daily vehicle pass ($12-$17 at Golden Gate Canyon) or an annual pass.

note: Forested drive-in campground at ~9,100 ft NW of Golden. No cell or internet service; emergency call box at the campground office. --Claude
summary: CPW camping page + every cpwshop site page: confirmed 50-amp electric, year-round (limited capacity in winter), showers/laundry/dump/flush toilets, reservation-only on cpwshop, $36 electric. Changed sites 97 -> 95 (58 electric A-E + 37 tent F-J). Added water/sewer false, max 50 ft, pull-throughs, url/window/fcfs never/14-night max, winter closures. flags: Other campgrounds at Golden Gate Canyon: Aspen Meadows (34 sites, all typed Tent on cpwshop with no vehicle length; 'closed in the winter, typically from late September to mid May'), the backcountry area ('All sites are a 1.5-2 mile hike in'; 20 tent sites and 4 shelters) and two group tent loops (Rifleman Phillips, Works Ranch). None is a drive-in RV campground, so none needs an entry.
CPW's park page says 'Full hook-up camping ... available', but no Reverend's Ridge site lists water or sewer on cpwshop; recorded water/sewer false from the site pages.
Entrance fee: the page gives a daily vehicle pass of $12-$17; the inherited state:CO row's entrance is resident $10 / non-resident $15. Not written (the page doesn't split the range by residency).
